subject: Request: TideBay contract exceptions - liability, warranty edits + commercial concession
messages:
From: David Lambert <david.lambert@tidebay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: TideBay Procurement <procurement@tidebay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TideBay SOW v3 + term asks (pilot)

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to send our follow-up with a few non-standard asks so we can get legal and finance to sign the pilot SOW. High level:

- Commercial: we need a 35% total first-year discount to help justify the pilot budget.
- Liability cap: TideBay needs the cap increased to $5,000,000 (we're proposing breach/loss carveouts).
- Indemnity: we want an additional paragraph making Redwood indemnify for third-party IP claims related to the model outputs.
- Warranty: we need a representation that outputs will not violate privacy or PHI regs during the pilot and a 30-day remedy window.

I've attached SOW v3 with TideBay redlines and SOC2 so you can share with your team. Can your legal team confirm whether these are deal-breakers for Redwood or if leadership can approve exceptions?

Appreciate a quick read — procurement would like to close the PO by month-end.

Best,
David
David Lambert
Head of Product Partnerships, TideBay
phone: +1-415-555-0123

Attachment: TideBay_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with in-line redlines), redlines_TideBay_sow.docx (track changes)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Lambert <david.lambert@tidebay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TideBay SOW v3 + term asks (pilot)

David — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. I'm looping in Legal (Marissa) and Sales leadership (Laura). We consider TideBay a strategic target so this is worth a quick internal review. I don't have authority on law/indemnity or to approve a 35% concession — that will need exec sign-off if Legal flags risk.

Next steps:
- Marissa: can you highlight which redlines are absolute blockers (IP indemnity/loss of liability cap, warranty language)?
- Laura: if Legal requires changes, can you indicate whether Sales can accept a partial discount or structured concession (e.g., milestone-based credit)?

I'll prepare a short escalation summary for Aditya if we need CEO authorization. Can Legal aim for an initial read by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE — West
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: TideBay SOW v3 + term asks (pilot)

Ben / Laura —

Reviewed TideBay's redlines and the SOW v3 attachment. High-level legal assessment:

1) Liability cap increase to $5M: risk-tolerant for a small pilot only if accompanied by: (a) clear aggregate cap language tied to fees paid (we should keep a multiplier floor), (b) exclusion for intentional misconduct and (c) a cap on consequential damages for third parties. If Sales wants $5M flat, we need exec sign-off.

2) IP indemnity for model outputs: this is a significant ask. Redwood's models are trained on public and licensed data; we cannot give broad IP indemnities for outputs. We can offer a limited indemnity for proven willful infringement by our code or models where we have control, but not for unpredictable generative outputs. Exec escalation required for any broader indemnity.

3) Warranty about privacy/PHI: can add a warranty stating Redwood will maintain SOC2 controls and not intentionally transmit PHI; however, we cannot warrant that outputs will be PHI-free if TideBay sends PHI in prompts. Suggest a carveout and an obligation on TideBay to refrain from sending PHI, plus remediation steps (30-day cure window).

4) Discount: commercial decision; Legal recommends linking any unusually large concession to a timeboxed pilot success metric and liability reconciliation — reduces moral hazard.

I have drafted suggested alternate clauses and tracked edits in redlines_TideBay_sow.docx. If Sales wants to pursue $5M cap and IP indemnity, I will prepare a redline for Exec review and a short risk memo.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TideBay SOW v3 + term asks (pilot)

Team —

Quick context from GTM: TideBay is running a consolidated pilot across three product lines and has committed to a potential enterprise-wide rollout next year if pilot metrics hit. They sign quickly and promote vendors internally. Losing momentum here likely kills the broader opportunity.

Commercial proposal to make Legal palatable and keep momentum:
- Approve a one-time 35% first-year discount for the pilot (35% applied to professional services + usage) subject to a signed pilot SOW by 31 July and milestone-based payment schedule.
- Approve a negotiated liability cap of $3,000,000 for pilot only (not unlimited), with a written acknowledgement that cap ties to fees paid and does not expand to future enterprise agreements.
- For IP indemnity, accept Legal's limited indemnity alternative (explicit carveouts for model outputs) — TideBay has pushed hard on this but may accept if commercial is attractive.

If Legal confirms the draft redlines above, Ben please escalate to Aditya requesting CEO-level sign-off for the liability cap uplift to $3M and the 35% concession. We need a one-sentence executive authorization to move forward.

Laura
Laura Bennett | VP, Sales 
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: TideBay - request for CEO sign-off on liability uplift + one-off discount

Aditya —

TL;DR: TideBay (strategic prospect) asks for a 35% first-year discount and to increase the liability cap to $5M with IP indemnity for model outputs. Legal (Marissa) flags IP indemnity and $5M cap as high risk. Sales (Laura) requests a compromise: one-time 35% pilot discount + liability cap uplift to $3M (pilot-only) and Legal's limited indemnity language.

Why this matters:
- TideBay runs a consolidated pilot across three product lines and has strong vendor influence internally — high upside for enterprise expansion.
- Procurement needs a PO in July or momentum stalls.

Ask:
1) Approve a one-time 35% first-year discount for the pilot (applies to PS + usage; timeboxed).
2) Authorize raising the liability cap to $3,000,000 for the pilot SOW only (explicitly not precedent for future contracts).
3) Delegate final sign-off to Legal to implement the limited indemnity carveouts recommended in the attached memo if you approve #1-2.

Attachments: redlines_TideBay_sow.docx (tracked changes) and a 1-pg risk memo from Legal.

If you can reply with a short OK / OK with edits / no, we can move quickly. Appreciate the quick read — procurement has a 31 July deadline to process.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: TideBay - request for CEO sign-off on liability uplift + one-off discount

Team —

Thanks for the concise summary. I agree with a pragmatic, risk-mitigated approach. Decision below: 

1) APPROVE the one-time 35% first-year discount for the pilot only, conditional on (a) signed SOW by 31 Jul, (b) milestone-based payments, and (c) a cap on total credits tied to the pilot fees.
2) APPROVE raising the pilot liability cap to $3,000,000 (pilot-only) with a strict written clause that this does not set a precedent for future enterprise agreements.
3) REJECT broad IP indemnity for model outputs. Legal to provide the limited indemnity language Marissa proposed. If TideBay pushes further on IP indemnity, route back to me with a clear dollarized risk estimate.

Marissa: proceed to finalize the redlines per the above and prepare a two-paragraph risk memo I can sign if needed for internal audit. Laura: Sales to offer the concession and tie it to measurable pilot milestones. Ben: proceed to close with procurement once docs are updated.

Aditya
Aditya Rao | Chief Executive Officer
Redwood Inference
